title: Claim
description: state/claims/<id>.json in the content repo: a run is building this paper's page. queue take writes and pushes it, so overlapping runs take different papers; publish deletes the run's claims. A claim older than three hours is stale and its paper can be taken again.

id.description: Stable paper id: arxiv-<id> or doi-<doi with every character outside a-z 0-9 . _ - replaced by ->, lowercase.

run.description: The name of the run that took the paper (queue take --run).

page.description: Which page the run is building: a full explainer or a quick explainer.

claimed_at.description: UTC time of the claim, RFC 3339.
